verdict.rationale: Zero's own repository documents an official ZeroMCP server exposing a broad email toolset: get threads, list folders, compose, send and draft, delete, labels, and search. It is a direct capability, but connecting is crude: you copy a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, OAuth is only 'coming soon', and the docs are a prose capability list with no endpoint schema or docs site. missing for 10: supported auth flow (OAuth), endpoint/connection schema and setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration of agents connecting

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can connecto ZeroMCP using two methods: 1. Better Auth session token 2. OAuth (Coming soon)
Copy the session cookie from your browser cookies and place it into the Authorization header.
Get email threads by ID - List emails in specific folders - Create and send new emails - Create email drafts - Send existing drafts - Delete emails
